title: Records with struc
description:
Describe a record with `struc` and walk an array of them.

```
Ada   score 91 level 14
Bob   score 48 level 9
Cy    score 77 level 12
best: Ada (91)
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

struc player
.name:  resb    8
.score: resd    1
.level: resd    1
endstruc

        section .data
players:
        istruc player
        at player.name, db "Ada", 0
        at player.score, dd 91
        at player.level, dd 14
        iend
count   equ     ($ - players) / player_size

        section .text
_start:
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `lea rbx, [rel players]` then `add rbx, player_size` moves to the next record (lesson 7.04).
`lea rdi, [rbx + player.name]` / `call print_str` prints a name; `mov edi, [rbx + player.score]` loads a score.
requirements: An array of three built with `istruc` / `at player.name, ...` / `iend`.
Step through it with `player_size` and read fields with `[rbx + player.score]`.
stretch: Sort the records by score by swapping whole records with `rep movsb`.
